data.name: Jaisal
data.gender_notes: Jaisal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaisal derives from the Sanskrit words jaya, meaning 'victory', and isal, meaning 'god'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture as a sign of divine favor and protection. The name Jaisal carries the meaning “Victory of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaisal usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the triumph of the divine over worldly struggles.
data.etymology: Jaisal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaisal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaisal holds great significance in Hindu culture, as it symbolizes victory and a divine connection. The name is believed to bestow blessings of strength, success, and good fortune upon the child. Moreover, the name Jaisal reflects the deep-rooted belief in Hinduism that one's spiritual and material success is solely in the hands of the gods.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jaisal holds immense spiritual significance in Hinduism, as it invokes the blessings of the divine. The name is a reminder that victory and success come from the grace of God, and that one must always remain humble and committed to spiritual growth. The name Jaisal encourages the pursuit of inner peace, happiness, and self-realization above worldly success.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jaisal is derived from "Jaisalmer," the golden city in Rajasthan, signifying the radiant and victorious spirit of its bearer. It symbolizes the inner strength and resilience, just as the city withstood numerous attacks and continued to shine.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jaisal was the founder of Jaisalmer in 1156 AD. The name Jaisal carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jaisal was a Rajput ruler who founded the city of Jaisalmer in the Thar Desert of Rajasthan.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jaisal remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Radha Jaisal from Delhi, India embodies the meaning of Jaisal - "Victory of God". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
